scope: Read-only bounded source-transition/extraction helper correctness review; no whole-goal/security certification

additional_controls.expected: accept latest manifest and preserve baseline

findings.title: Active whole-package frozen baseline is not verified
findings.observed: Current verification does not inspect packages[].frozen_before against baseline_inputs. A cloned active-package fixture with corrupted frozen source and manifest passes split.verify with no errors. The same recovery bytes are outside source_inputs unless individually named by a transition.
findings.required_fix: Verify every active package recovery input against original baseline_inputs as a regular, independent recovery file. Reject changed, missing, symlinked or current-alias recovery before build/verify acceptance.
findings.actual_workspace: All17 active whole-package frozen input files currently match their baseline SHA and are regular independent files.

findings.title: SDK and partial recovery can alias mutable current source
findings.observed: The partial and SDK checks validate frozen is_file+SHA but do not reject symlinks or frozen.resolve()==current.resolve(). Both sections accept a frozen symlink to the current source and frozen_before set to the current source itself;4 cloned fixtures pass.
findings.required_fix: Require frozen recovery regular files and reject current-file aliases for both sections. Keep original forwarding alias and unique canonical authority checks.
findings.actual_workspace: All9 partial recovery files and10 SDK recovery files currently have matching SHA, regular independent recovery files, and correct original forwarding symlinks.

findings.title: Build success can be recorded after registered input drift
findings.observed: source_inputs and candidate hashes are checked only before build. A fake local tool mutating registered Move.toml or Move.lock during build/test produces exit0/test0 accepted evidence and updates the workspace build pointer; a postbuild source_inputs then rejects the changed input. The Move.toml fixture also records a candidate SHA that differs from the actual final manifest.
findings.required_fix: Use an isolated build/install directory for build and test; check the full registered current/frozen inputs again after both commands and before success/evidence acceptance. Bind evidence to the current expected inputs used for the graph; preserve original candidate and52-row baseline SHA.
findings.qualification: Observed commands contain no --install-dir. This review proves missing post-tool guard with an offline fake tool; it does not assert that an actual Sui invocation mutated any source or lock.
